candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately when _tos.length == 0 instead of reverting, altering return behavior for empty _tos.
Invert final return: always return false at end instead of true, changing observable return for successful runs.
Remove the per-iteration require so failed inner calls don't revert; instead track a boolean and return it (true if all succeeded), changing return value when some inner calls fail.
Change the call to use delegatecall instead of call, altering which contract's storage/execution context handles transferFrom and thus observable effects.
Invert the success check to require the inner call to fail (require(!_s)), causing different observable outcomes when inner calls succeed or revert.
Remove the require on _tos.length so empty _tos arrays are allowed, changing observable behavior when called with empty arrays.
